Good to know

Quick answers before you download.

Is it free?

Yes. Browsing and downloading through our Discord is free.

Which Minecraft version do I need?

Each client lists its supported versions on its card and in its Discord post. Match them before installing.

Is it safe?

Only download from the official ClientGate Discord, and scan files like you would anything else. Never download from links sent in DMs.

Can I request a client?

Of course — drop your suggestion in the Discord and the team will take a look.

Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

ClientGate is an independent community project. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios.
